events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Dylan Larkin scored at 3:07 of overtime as the Detroit Red Wings downed the Toronto Maple Leafs 2-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Larkin scores winner, Red Wings top Maple Leafs 2-1 in overtime

headlines.description: — Mikael Granlund and Cutter Gauthier scored in the shootout and Lukas Dostal stopped 40 shots as Anaheim defeated the NHL-leading Colorado Avalanche for the Ducks' fifth straight win Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Granlund, Gauthier score in shootout as Ducks beat Avalanche 2-1

headlines.description: — Clayton Keller scored two twice to help the Utah Mammoth rally from a three-goal deficit and beat the Philadelphia Flyers 5-4 in overtime on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clayton Keller's 2 late goals rally Mammoth past Flyers for 5-4 OT victory

headlines.description: — Tommy Novak and Evgeni Malkin each had a goal and an assist as the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Calgary Flames 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stuart Skinner stops 18 shots and helps Penguins to a 4-1 win over the Flames

events.name: New York Islanders at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: Vince Dunn and Jared McCann had a goal and an assist each and the Seattle Kraken snapped a four-game skid with a 4-1 win over the New York Islanders on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kraken snap four-game skid with 4-1 win over Islanders

headlines.description: — Brock Boeser had a goal and an assist as the Vancouver Canucks erased an early-two goal deficit and held on to end their 11-game losing streak with a 4-3 win over the Washington Capitals on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canucks rally to end 11-game losing streak with 4-3 win over Capitals
